notes: The replay used to slow down at the single lowest-scoring frame of your clip — so one pose misread, a lone bad frame between good ones, became ‘the moment that scored lowest’ and the clip slowed to quarter speed there, even though the report and the clip markers showed no fault at all. The replay now slows at the same held worst moment the markers flag: a low score has to last at least two frames to count, and a clip with no real worst moment doesn’t slow down at an ordinary frame.
